```{r}
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------#
# --------------------Carga de datos, metadatos y filtrado--------------------#
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------#

# Lectura de conteos y metadatos
raw_counts <- read_tsv(
  here("data/processed/counts/gene_counts_clean.tsv"),
  comment = "#")

colData <- read_tsv(
  here("data/metadata/metadata.tsv")) %>% # metadata.tsv fue ubicado manualmente
  column_to_rownames("sample") %>%
  mutate( # Especificamos los niveles de group (condition, time) con sus SRR
    condition = factor(
      condition,
      levels = c("axenic", "coculture")),
    time = factor(
      time,
      levels = c("8h", "13h")),
    replicate = factor(replicate),
    group = factor(group,
      levels = c("axenic_8h","coculture_8h","axenic_13h","coculture_13h")))

# Carga de matriz de conteos y limpieza
counts_matrix <- raw_counts %>%
  column_to_rownames("Geneid") %>% # Asignación geneid como identificador
  select(starts_with("data/processed/aligned")) 

colnames(counts_matrix) <- colnames(counts_matrix) %>%
  basename() %>%
  str_remove("\\.bam")

# Filtrado por baja abundancia (>= 10 en las 3 réplicas) 
keep <- rowSums(counts_matrix >= 10) >= 3
counts_filtered <- counts_matrix[keep,]
```

```{r}
#--------------------------------------------------------#
# MODELADO por grupos DESeq2 (~group), VST y métricas QC #
#--------------------------------------------------------#
# Creación objeto DESeqDataSet (dds)
dds_group <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
  countData = counts_filtered,
  colData = colData,
  design = ~ group)

dds_group <- DESeq(dds_group)

# Transformación VST para exploración
vsd_group <- vst(dds_group, blind = TRUE) # ignoramos las etiquetas del dds_group

# Extracción de matriz PCA y distancias entre muestras
pca_data_group <- plotPCA(vsd_group, intgroup = c("condition", "time"), returnData = TRUE)
percentVar_group <- round(100 * attr(pca_data_group, "percentVar"))

sample_distances_group <- dist(t(assay(vsd_group)))
sample_dist_matrix_group <- as.matrix(sample_distances_group)
```

```{r}
#-------------------------------------------------------------#
# Contrastes 8h/13h, Extracción DEGs y clasificación temporal #
#-------------------------------------------------------------#
# Incorporación contrastes ashr
res_8h_shrink  <- lfcShrink(dds_group, contrast = c("group", "coculture_8h", "axenic_8h"), type = "ashr")
res_13h_shrink <- lfcShrink(dds_group, contrast = c("group", "coculture_13h", "axenic_13h"), type = "ashr")

# Función que transforma res_shrink y convierte nombres filas en Geneid
# para filtrado simple
get_deg_table <- function(res_shrink, padj_cut = 0.05, lfc_cut = 1) {
  as.data.frame(res_shrink) %>%
    rownames_to_column("Geneid") %>%
    mutate(
      diffexpressed = case_when(
        padj < padj_cut & log2FoldChange > lfc_cut  ~ "Up",
        padj < padj_cut & log2FoldChange < -lfc_cut ~ "Down",
        TRUE ~ "NoDEG"))}

deg_8h  <- get_deg_table(res_8h_shrink)
deg_13h <- get_deg_table(res_13h_shrink)

degs_8h  <- deg_8h %>% filter(diffexpressed != "NoDEG") %>% pull(Geneid)
degs_13h <- deg_13h %>% filter(diffexpressed != "NoDEG") %>% pull(Geneid)
all_degs <- unique(c(degs_8h, degs_13h))

# Clasificación de patrones temporales
deg_classified <- tibble(Geneid = all_degs) %>%
  mutate(
    status_8h  = deg_8h$diffexpressed[match(Geneid, deg_8h$Geneid)],
    status_13h = deg_13h$diffexpressed[match(Geneid, deg_13h$Geneid)],
    pattern = case_when(
      status_8h == "Up"   & status_13h == "NoDEG" ~ "Early Up",
      status_8h == "Down" & status_13h == "NoDEG" ~ "Early Down",
      status_8h == "NoDEG" & status_13h == "Up"   ~ "Late Up",
      status_8h == "NoDEG" & status_13h == "Down" ~ "Late Down",
      status_8h == "Up"   & status_13h == "Up"   ~ "Sustained Up",
      status_8h == "Down" & status_13h == "Down" ~ "Sustained Down",
      status_8h != status_13h & status_8h != "NoDEG" & status_13h != "NoDEG" ~ "Inverted",
      TRUE ~ "Other"))

# Matrices escaladas para heatmaps
mat_8h  <- t(scale(t(assay(vsd_group)[degs_8h, ])))
mat_13h <- t(scale(t(assay(vsd_group)[degs_13h, ])))

# Listas de genes activados/reprimidos
#up_genes <- list("Up 8h" = deg_8h$Geneid[deg_8h$diffexpressed == "Up"], "Up 13h" = deg_13h$Geneid[deg_13h$diffexpressed == "Up"])
#down_genes <- list("Down 8h" = deg_8h$Geneid[deg_8h$diffexpressed == "Down"], "Down 13h" = deg_13h$Geneid[deg_13h$diffexpressed == "Down"])
```

```{r}
#---------------------------------------------------------#
#  Gráficas - Volcano plots, Heatmaps y Diagramas de Venn #
#---------------------------------------------------------#
# Función para volcano plots
plot_volcano <- function(deg_df, title) {
  deg_df_clean <- deg_df %>% drop_na(padj)
  ggplot(deg_df_clean, aes(x = log2FoldChange, y = -log10(padj), color = diffexpressed)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.5, size = 1.5) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("Down" = "blue", "NoDEG" = "grey", "Up" = "red")) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = c(-1, 1), linetype = "dashed") +
    geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed") +
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(title = title, x = "Log2 Fold Change (Shrunk)", y = "-Log10 p-adjusted")}

p_volc_8h  <- plot_volcano(deg_8h, "Cocultivo vs Axenic (8h)")
p_volc_13h <- plot_volcano(deg_13h, "Cocultivo vs Axenic (13h)")

# Combinación y extracción VOLCANO
fig_volcanos <- p_volc_8h + p_volc_13h
ggsave(here("results/figures/Fig_Volcano_Plots_8h_&_13h.png"), fig_volcanos, width = 10, height = 4.5, dpi = 300)

# Diagrama de Venn genes activados/reprimidos

# Listas de genes activados/reprimidos
up_genes <- list("Up 8h" = deg_8h$Geneid[deg_8h$diffexpressed == "Up"], "Up 13h" = deg_13h$Geneid[deg_13h$diffexpressed == "Up"])
down_genes <- list("Down 8h" = deg_8h$Geneid[deg_8h$diffexpressed == "Down"], "Down 13h" = deg_13h$Geneid[deg_13h$diffexpressed == "Down"])

up_list <- list(
  "Up 8h"  = up_genes[["Up 8h"]],
  "Up 13h" = up_genes[["Up 13h"]])

down_list <- list(
  "Down 8h"  = down_genes[["Down 8h"]],
  "Down 13h" = down_genes[["Down 13h"]])

p_venn_up <- ggvenn(
  up_list, 
  fill_color = c("royalblue", "lightcyan"),
  stroke_size = 0.5, 
  set_name_size = 4,
  text_size = 3.5) + 
  ggtitle("Genes Activados (Up)")

p_venn_down <- ggvenn(
  down_list, 
  fill_color = c("yellow", "darkorange"),
  stroke_size = 0.5, 
  set_name_size = 4,
  text_size = 3.5) + 
  ggtitle("Genes Reprimidos (Down)")

# Combinación y extracción VENN
fig_venns <- p_venn_up + p_venn_down
ggsave(here("results/figures/Fig_Venn_Diagrams_Up_Down.png"), fig_venns, width = 9, height = 4, dpi = 300)
```

```{r}
#----------------------------------------------------------------#
# MODELADO factorial DESeq2 (~condition*time), interacción y VST #
#----------------------------------------------------------------#
dds_interaction <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
  countData = counts_filtered,
  colData   = colData,
  design    = ~ condition * time) # evalúa si la respuesta en time cambia según condición

dds_interaction <- DESeq(dds_interaction)

# Ajustado por shrinkage
res_interaction_shrink <- lfcShrink(
  dds_interaction,
  coef = "conditioncoculture.time13h", # mide cuánto cambia t13h en cocultivo respecto control (axenic 8h)
  type = "ashr")

interaction_table <- as.data.frame(res_interaction_shrink) %>%
  rownames_to_column("Geneid") %>%
  mutate(
    diffexpressed = case_when(
      padj < 0.05 & log2FoldChange > 1  ~ "Interaction Up", #expresión mayor en cocultivo
      padj < 0.05 & log2FoldChange < -1 ~ "Interaction Down", #expresión menor en cocultivo
      TRUE ~ "NoDEG"))

interaction_genes <- interaction_table %>% filter(diffexpressed != "NoDEG") %>% pull(Geneid)

vsd_interaction <- vst(dds_interaction, blind = FALSE) # evita sobreestimación
mat_interaction <- t(scale(t(assay(vsd_interaction)[interaction_genes, ])))
```

```{r}
#--------------------------------------------------------------#
# Gráficas - Volcano plot y Heatmap con la interacción #
#--------------------------------------------------------------#
plot_volcano_interaction <- function(df, title) {
  df_clean <- df %>% drop_na(padj)
  ggplot(df_clean, aes(x = log2FoldChange, y = -log10(padj), color = diffexpressed)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.5, size = 1.5) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("Interaction Down" = "blue", "NoDEG" = "grey", "Interaction Up" = "red")) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = c(-1, 1), linetype = "dashed") +
    geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed") +
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(title = title, x = "Efecto Diferencial del Co-cultivo (Interacción)", y = "-Log10 p-adjusted")}

# Extracción volcanos, heatmap
p_volc_inter <- plot_volcano_interaction(interaction_table, "Volcano Plot: Interacción Condición x Tiempo")
ggsave(here("results/figures/Fig_Volcano_Plot_Interaccion.png"), p_volc_inter, width = 6, height = 5, dpi = 300)

png(here("results/figures/Fig_Heatmap_Interaccion_Condition_Time.png"), width = 8.5, height = 7, units = "in", res = 300)
pheatmap(
  mat_interaction,
  annotation_col = as.data.frame(colData(dds_interaction)[, c("condition", "time")]),
  show_rownames = FALSE, cluster_cols = TRUE, cluster_rows = TRUE, treeheight_row = 0,
  main = paste("Genes con interacción condición x tiempo (N =", length(interaction_genes), ")"))
dev.off()

```

```{r}
#------------------------------------------------------------------#
# Análisis - Anotación funcional e integración en tabla maestra #
#------------------------------------------------------------------#
# Carga de la anotación resultado de eggnog-mapper
eggnog_raw <- read_tsv(here("data/processed/annotation/query.emapper.annotations"), comment = "##") %>%
  rename(Geneid = `#query`) %>% 
  mutate(Geneid = str_remove(Geneid, "^gene-"))

# Lectura de definiciones oficiales COG en NCBI
cog_def_official <- read_tsv(
  "https://ftp.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pub/COG/COG2024/data/cog-24.def.tab", # USo de versión más reciente
  col_names = c("COG_ID", "COG_letter", "COG_Name", "Gene", "Pathway", "PubMed_IDs", "PDB_IDs"),
  col_types = "ccccccc") # lectura de las columnas como character

cog_fun_raw <- read_lines("https://ftp.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pub/COG/COG2024/data/cog-24.fun.tab")

cog_fun_official <- tibble(line = cog_fun_raw) %>%
  filter(str_detect(line, "^[A-Z]\\s+")) %>%
  mutate(
    COG_letter = str_extract(line, "^[A-Z]"),
    Category_Name = str_extract(line, "[^\t]+$")) %>%
  select(COG_letter, Category_Name)

# Integración TABLA DEGs con anotación eggnog-mapper
deg_annotated_master <- deg_classified %>%
  left_join(
    eggnog_raw %>% select(Geneid, COG_ID = COG_category, Preferred_name, GOs, KEGG_Pathway, PFAMs),
    by = "Geneid") %>%
  left_join(cog_def_official %>% select(COG_ID, COG_letter, COG_Name), by = "COG_ID") %>%
  left_join(cog_fun_official, by = "COG_letter")

# Exportación de deg_annotated_master
write.csv(deg_annotated_master, here("results/anexo_tabla_maestra_anotacion.csv"))
```

```{r}
#--------------------------------------------------------#
# Preparación del universo de genes y mapeos funcionales #
#--------------------------------------------------------#

# Los genes que pasan filtro de abundancia inicial son el Universo
gene_universe <- rownames(counts_filtered)

# Agrupación directa para compareCluster
gene_clusters <- deg_classified %>%
  filter(pattern != "Other") %>% # Se excluyen patrones no identificados
  split(.$pattern) %>%
  lapply(function(x) x$Geneid)

#-----------------------------------------------#
# Mapeos KEGG - Extracción y relación ID-Nombre #
#-----------------------------------------------#
term_to_gene_kegg <- eggnog_raw %>%
  select(Geneid, KEGG_Pathway) %>%
  drop_na(KEGG_Pathway) %>%
  filter(KEGG_Pathway != "-" & KEGG_Pathway != "") %>%
  separate_rows(KEGG_Pathway, sep = ",") %>%
  mutate(KEGG_Pathway = str_extract(KEGG_Pathway, "\\d{5}")) %>%
  drop_na(KEGG_Pathway) %>%
  select(KEGG_Pathway, Geneid)

term2name_pathway <- keggList("pathway") %>%
  enframe(name = "KEGG_Pathway", value = "Pathway_Name") %>%
  mutate(
    KEGG_Pathway = str_extract(KEGG_Pathway, "\\d{5}"),
    Pathway_Name = str_remove(Pathway_Name, " - Bacillus velezensis.*"))

#---------------------#
# Mapeos GO (BP y MF) #
#---------------------#
term_to_gene_go <- eggnog_raw %>%
  select(Geneid, GOs) %>%
  drop_na(GOs) %>%
  filter(GOs != "-" & GOs != "") %>%
  separate_rows(GOs, sep = ",") %>%
  mutate(GOs = str_trim(GOs)) %>%
  select(GOID = GOs, Geneid) %>%
  distinct()

go_info <- AnnotationDbi::select( # acceso a base de datos GO
  GO.db,
  keys     = unique(term_to_gene_go$GOID),
  columns  = c("GOID", "TERM", "ONTOLOGY"),
  keytype  = "GOID") %>% 
  drop_na(ONTOLOGY)

# Creación de subconjuntos por ontología según IDs
# GO-BP
t2g_bp <- term_to_gene_go %>% 
  filter(GOID %in% (go_info %>% filter(ONTOLOGY == "BP") %>% pull(GOID)))
t2n_bp <- go_info %>% filter(ONTOLOGY == "BP") %>% select(GOID, TERM)

# GO-MF
t2g_mf <- term_to_gene_go %>% 
  filter(GOID %in% (go_info %>% filter(ONTOLOGY == "MF") %>% pull(GOID)))
t2n_mf <- go_info %>% filter(ONTOLOGY == "MF") %>% select(GOID, TERM)
```

```{r}
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------#
# ------------------------------Análisis ORA-----------------------------------#
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------#

#--------------------------------------------------------------#
# ORA KEGG (Rutas inducidas vs reprimidas por patrón temporal) #
#--------------------------------------------------------------#
cluster_up <- deg_classified %>% 
  filter(str_detect(pattern, "Up")) %>% 
  split(.$pattern) %>% 
  lapply(function(x) x$Geneid)

cluster_down <- deg_classified %>% 
  filter(str_detect(pattern, "Down")) %>% 
  split(.$pattern) %>% 
  lapply(function(x) x$Geneid)

#----------#
# ORA KEGG #
#----------#
comp_kegg_up <- compareCluster(
  geneClusters  = cluster_up,
  fun           = "enricher",
  universe      = gene_universe,
  TERM2GENE     = term_to_gene_kegg,
  TERM2NAME     = term2name_pathway,
  pAdjustMethod = "BH",
  pvalueCutoff  = 0.05)

comp_kegg_down <- compareCluster(
  geneClusters  = cluster_down,
  fun           = "enricher",
  universe      = gene_universe,
  TERM2GENE     = term_to_gene_kegg,
  TERM2NAME     = term2name_pathway,
  pAdjustMethod = "BH",
  pvalueCutoff  = 0.05)

#-----------#
# ORA GO-BP #
#-----------#
comp_go_bp <- compareCluster(
  geneClusters  = gene_clusters, # Usa todos los clústeres temporales (Up y Down)
  fun           = "enricher",
  universe      = gene_universe,
  TERM2GENE     = t2g_bp,
  TERM2NAME     = t2n_bp,
  pAdjustMethod = "BH",
  pvalueCutoff  = 0.05)

# Dotplots ORA KEGG Up / Down
# Panel A: KEGG Up
p_kegg_up <- dotplot(comp_kegg_up, showCategory = 8, label_format = 25) + # etiquetas de formateo a 25 char
  labs(title = "A) Rutas KEGG Sobrerrepresentadas\n(Inducidas)", x = NULL, y = "Ruta KEGG") +
  theme_bw() + 
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 8),
        plot.title = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"))

# Panel B: KEGG Down (título con \n para evitar solapamiento)
p_kegg_down <- dotplot(comp_kegg_down, showCategory = 8, label_format = 25) +
  labs(title = "B) Rutas KEGG Sobrerrepresentadas\n(Reprimidas)", x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme_bw() + 
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 8),
        plot.title = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"))

# Panel C: GO-BP
p_go_bp <- dotplot(comp_go_bp, showCategory = 8, label_format = 35) +
  labs(title = "C) Procesos Biológicos (GO-BP) Sobrerrepresentados", x = "Patrón Temporal", y = "Término GO (BP)") +
  theme_bw() + 
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 8),
        plot.title = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"))

# Unificación paneles
fig_ora_combined <- (p_kegg_up | p_kegg_down) / p_go_bp + 
  plot_layout(heights = c(1.2, 1), widths = c(1, 1.1))

# Extracción dotplot combinado
ggsave(here("results/figures/Fig_ORA_KEGG_GOBP.png"), fig_ora_combined, width = 14, height = 12, dpi = 300)

# TABLA MEMORIA Rutas metabólicas (KEGG) y procesos biológicos (GO-BP) significativamente enriquecidos por clúster temporal (ORA, FDR < 0.05)
# Aglutinación ORA
resumen_ora_verificado <- bind_rows(
  as.data.frame(comp_kegg_up) %>% mutate(DB = "KEGG"),
  as.data.frame(comp_kegg_down) %>% mutate(DB = "KEGG"),
  as.data.frame(comp_go_bp) %>% mutate(DB = "GO-BP"))

# Selección de columnas
tabla_docx_ora <- resumen_ora_verificado %>%
  group_by(Cluster, DB) %>%
  slice_min(order_by = p.adjust, n = 3, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(Description = str_replace_all(Description, "/", "/ ")) %>% 
  select(Cluster, DB, Description, GeneRatio, p.adjust) %>%
  mutate(p.adjust = formatC(p.adjust, format = "e", digits = 2))

# Construcción flextable
ft_ora <- flextable(tabla_docx_ora) %>%
  set_header_labels(
    Cluster     = "Patrón Temporal",
    DB          = "Fuente",
    Description = "Ruta / Proceso Biológico",
    GeneRatio   = "GeneRatio",
    p.adjust    = "p-adj (FDR)") %>%
  theme_vanilla() %>%
  
  # Tipografía
  fontsize(size = 8.5, part = "all") %>%
  fontsize(size = 8.5, part = "header") %>%
  bold(part = "header") %>%
  italic(j = "Description", part = "body") %>%
  bg(bg = "white", part = "header") %>%
  
  # Alineaciones
  align(align = "center", part = "all") %>%
  align(j = c("Cluster", "Description"), align = "left", part = "body") %>%
  
  # Anchos para memoria 
  width(j = "Cluster",     width = 1.1) %>%
  width(j = "DB",          width = 0.6) %>%
  width(j = "Description", width = 3.5) %>%
  width(j = "GeneRatio",   width = 0.7) %>%
  width(j = "p.adjust",    width = 0.7) %>%
  
  # Relleno de celdas
  padding(padding.top = 3, padding.bottom = 3, padding.left = 2, padding.right = 2, part = "all")

save_as_docx(ft_ora, path = here("results/Tabla_ORA_Summary_Formatted.docx"))
```
```{r}
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------#
# ------------------------------Análisis GSEA----------------------------------#
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------#

# Función  para crear la matriz rankeada de genes
create_ranked_list <- function(res_shrink) {
  res_shrink %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    rownames_to_column("Geneid") %>%
    drop_na(log2FoldChange) %>%
    dplyr::select(Geneid, log2FoldChange) %>%
    deframe() %>%
    sort(decreasing = TRUE)}

ranked_8h  <- create_ranked_list(res_8h_shrink)
ranked_13h <- create_ranked_list(res_13h_shrink)

set.seed(123) # Para reproducibilidad

# ---------------------------#
# GSEA rutas KEGG (8h y 13h) #
# ---------------------------#
gsea_kegg_8h <- GSEA(geneList = ranked_8h, TERM2GENE = term_to_gene_kegg, TERM2NAME = term2name_pathway, pvalueCutoff = 0.05, pAdjustMethod = "BH", verbose = FALSE)
gsea_kegg_13h <- GSEA(geneList = ranked_13h, TERM2GENE = term_to_gene_kegg, TERM2NAME = term2name_pathway, pvalueCutoff = 0.05, pAdjustMethod = "BH", verbose = FALSE)

# --------------#
# 2. GSEA GO-BP #
# --------------#
gsea_bp_8h  <- GSEA(geneList = ranked_8h,  TERM2GENE = t2g_bp, TERM2NAME = t2n_bp, pvalueCutoff = 0.25, pAdjustMethod = "BH", verbose = FALSE)
gsea_bp_13h <- GSEA(geneList = ranked_13h, TERM2GENE = t2g_bp, TERM2NAME = t2n_bp, pvalueCutoff = 0.25, pAdjustMethod = "BH", verbose = FALSE)

# --------------#
# 3. GSEA GO-MF #
# --------------#
gsea_mf_8h  <- GSEA(geneList = ranked_8h,  TERM2GENE = t2g_mf, TERM2NAME = t2n_mf, pvalueCutoff = 0.25, pAdjustMethod = "BH", verbose = FALSE)
gsea_mf_13h <- GSEA(geneList = ranked_13h, TERM2GENE = t2g_mf, TERM2NAME = t2n_mf, pvalueCutoff = 0.25, pAdjustMethod = "BH", verbose = FALSE)

# Distinción de filas por ontología empleada y aglutinación en un .csv
bind_rows(
  as.data.frame(gsea_kegg_8h)  %>% mutate(time = "8h",  ontology = "KEGG"),
  as.data.frame(gsea_kegg_13h) %>% mutate(time = "13h", ontology = "KEGG"),
  as.data.frame(gsea_bp_8h)    %>% mutate(time = "8h",  ontology = "GO-BP"),
  as.data.frame(gsea_bp_13h)   %>% mutate(time = "13h", ontology = "GO-BP"),
  as.data.frame(gsea_mf_8h)    %>% mutate(time = "8h",  ontology = "GO-MF"),
  as.data.frame(gsea_mf_13h)   %>% mutate(time = "13h", ontology = "GO-MF")) %>% 
  arrange(p.adjust) %>% 
  write_csv(here("results/anexo_gsea_results_all_8h_13h.csv"))

# TABLA MEMORIA GSEA KEGG/GO-BP y GO-MF
# Extraer datos significativos/exploratorios a 13h
top_kegg_13h <- as.data.frame(gsea_kegg_13h) %>%
  filter(p.adjust < 0.05) %>% # significativo
  mutate(Domain = "KEGG") %>%
  select(Domain, Description, setSize, NES, p.adjust)

top_go_bp_13h <- as.data.frame(gsea_bp_13h) %>%
  filter(p.adjust < 0.25) %>% # exploratorio
  mutate(Domain = "GO-BP") %>%
  select(Domain, Description, setSize, NES, p.adjust)

top_go_mf_13h <- as.data.frame(gsea_mf_13h) %>%
  filter(p.adjust < 0.25) %>% # exploratorio
  mutate(Domain = "GO-MF") %>%
  select(Domain, Description, setSize, NES, p.adjust)

# Unificación
gsea_summary_table <- bind_rows(top_kegg_13h, top_go_bp_13h, top_go_mf_13h) %>%
  mutate(
    Description = str_replace_all(Description, "/", "/ "),
    NES = sprintf("%.2f", NES),
    p.adjust = formatC(p.adjust, format = "e", digits = 2))

# Consolidar y formatear texto / nums
ft_gsea <- flextable(gsea_summary_table) %>%
  set_header_labels(
    Domain      = "Dominio",
    Description = "Ruta / Proceso Biológico / Función",
    setSize     = "Tamaño",
    NES         = "NES",
    p.adjust    = "p-adj (FDR)") %>%
  theme_vanilla() %>%
  fontsize(size = 8.5, part = "all") %>%
  bold(part = "header") %>%
  italic(j = "Description", part = "body") %>%
  bg(bg = "white", part = "header") %>%
  align(align = "center", part = "all") %>%
  align(j = c("Domain", "Description"), align = "left", part = "body") %>%
  width(j = "Domain",      width = 0.8) %>%
  width(j = "Description", width = 3.8) %>%
  width(j = "setSize",     width = 0.6) %>%
  width(j = "NES",         width = 0.6) %>%
  width(j = "p.adjust",    width = 0.8) %>%
  set_table_properties(layout = "fixed") %>%
  padding(padding.top = 3, padding.bottom = 3, padding.left = 2, padding.right = 2, part = "all")

save_as_docx(ft_gsea, path = here("results/Tabla_GSEA_Summary_Formatted.docx"))

#---------------#
# GRÁFICAS KEGG #
#---------------#
# Dotplot Comparativo 8h vs 13h (KEGG)
valid_gsea_kegg <- list("8h" = gsea_kegg_8h, "13h" = gsea_kegg_13h) %>% 
  keep(~ !is.null(.x) && nrow(as.data.frame(.x)) > 0)

if (length(valid_gsea_kegg) > 0) {
  p_dotplot <- dotplot(merge_result(valid_gsea_kegg), showCategory = 10) +

  ggsave(here("results/figures/Fig_gsea_kegg_dotplot_8h_vs_13h.png"), plot = p_dotplot, width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300)}

# Plots específicos 13h KEGG
# Ridgeplot
if (!is.null(gsea_kegg_13h) && nrow(as.data.frame(gsea_kegg_13h)) > 0) {
  
  p_ridge <- ridgeplot(gsea_kegg_13h, showCategory = 8) +
```

```{r}
# Tabla completa de proporciones COG (top 3 por patrón)
cog_top3_clean <- deg_annotated_master %>%
  filter(!is.na(COG_letter) & COG_letter != "-") %>%
  filter(!is.na(Category_Name) & Category_Name != "") %>%
  filter(!COG_letter %in% c("S", "R")) %>% # Separación de funciones desconocidas y generales
  separate_rows(COG_letter, sep = "") %>% # Separación de múltiples letras asignadas
  filter(COG_letter != "") %>%
  count(pattern, Category_Name) %>%
  group_by(pattern) %>%
  mutate(prop = round(n / sum(n) * 100, 1)) %>%
  slice_max(order_by = prop, n = 3, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(Category_Name_wrapped = str_wrap(Category_Name, width = 25)) %>% # salto de línea si línea > 25 char
  mutate(Category_Name_wrapped = reorder_within(Category_Name_wrapped, prop, pattern))

# Generación y guardado de figura COG
fig_cog <- ggplot(cog_top3_clean, aes(x = prop, y = Category_Name_wrapped, fill = pattern)) +
  geom_col(show.legend = FALSE, width = 0.7) +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(prop, "%")), hjust = -0.15, size = 2.6) +
  facet_wrap(~ pattern, scales = "free", ncol = 2) +
  scale_y_reordered() +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::label_percent(scale = 1), limits = c(0,max(cog_top3_clean$prop) * 1.35), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  labs(title = "Principales Categorías COG por Patrón Temporal", x = "Proporción de genes (%)", y = NULL) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(strip.background = element_rect(fill = "lightgray"),
        strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 9),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 7.5, lineheight = 0.85),
        panel.grid.major.y = element_blank())

ggsave(here("results/figures/Fig_Categorias_COG_por_Patron_Temporal.png"), fig_cog, width = 9, height = 8, dpi = 300)
```

```{r}
#-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------#
# Lectura e integración antiSMASH - extracción BGCs, cruze con DEGs y tabla resumen #
#-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------#
# Lectura del archivo json incorporado PREVIAMENTE
antismash_json_path <- here("data/processed/annotation/NZ_CP034203.1/NZ_CP034203.1.json") 
antismash_raw <- fromJSON(file = antismash_json_path)

# Creación de un a función que itere sobre cada registro del .json
df_bgc_genes <- map_df(antismash_raw$records, function(rec) {
  features <- rec$features
  
  # Regiones
  df_reg <- keep(features, ~ .x$type == "region") %>%
    map_df(function(r) {
      q <- r$qualifiers
      tibble(
        Region      = paste0("Region_", q$region_number[[1]] %||% NA_character_),
        BGC_Product = paste(unlist(q$product), collapse = "/"),
        reg_start   = as.numeric(str_extract(r$location, "(?<=\\[)\\d+")),
        reg_end     = as.numeric(str_extract(r$location, "(?<=:)\\d+")))})

  # CDS
  df_cds <- keep(features, ~ .x$type == "CDS") %>%
    map_df(function(c) {
      q <- c$qualifiers
      tibble(
        Geneid    = str_remove(q$locus_tag[[1]] %||% NA_character_, "^gene-"),
        Gene_Name = q$gene[[1]] %||% q$locus_tag[[1]] %||% NA_character_,
        Gene_Kind = q$gene_kind[[1]] %||% "other",
        cds_start = as.numeric(str_extract(c$location, "(?<=\\[)\\d+")),
        cds_end   = as.numeric(str_extract(c$location, "(?<=:)\\d+")))}) %>% 
    filter(!is.na(Geneid))
  
  # Asignación por coordenadas
  df_cds %>%
    cross_join(df_reg) %>%
    filter(cds_start >= reg_start & cds_end <= reg_end) %>%
    select(Region, BGC_Product, Geneid, Gene_Name, Gene_Kind)}) %>% 
  distinct()

# Cruce con DEGs
bgc_deg_master <- df_bgc_genes %>%
  left_join(deg_8h %>% select(Geneid, LFC_8h = log2FoldChange, padj_8h = padj, status_8h = diffexpressed), by = "Geneid") %>%
  left_join(deg_13h %>% select(Geneid, LFC_13h = log2FoldChange, padj_13h = padj, status_13h = diffexpressed), by = "Geneid") %>%
  left_join(interaction_table %>% select(Geneid, LFC_Inter = log2FoldChange, padj_Inter = padj, status_Inter = diffexpressed), by = "Geneid") %>%
  mutate(across(starts_with("status_"), ~ replace_na(.x, "NoDEG")))

# Agrupación de clusters por regiones
bgc_dynamics_table <- bgc_deg_master %>%
  group_by(Region, BGC_Product) %>%
  summarise(
    # Conteos por categoría, eliminando NAs
    Total_Genes        = n(),
    Core_Total         = sum(Gene_Kind == "biosynthetic", na.rm = TRUE),
    BioAdd_Total       = sum(Gene_Kind == "biosynthetic-additional", na.rm = TRUE),
    Transporters       = sum(Gene_Kind == "transport", na.rm = TRUE),
    Regulators         = sum(Gene_Kind == "regulatory", na.rm = TRUE),
    Other_Genes        = sum(Gene_Kind == "other", na.rm = TRUE),
    Total_Biosynthetic = Core_Total + BioAdd_Total,
    
    # Actividad Biosintética (8 vs 13h)
    Core_Up_8h         = sum(Gene_Kind == "biosynthetic" & status_8h == "Up", na.rm = TRUE),
    Core_Up_13h        = sum(Gene_Kind == "biosynthetic" & status_13h == "Up", na.rm = TRUE),
    All_Bio_Up_8h      = sum(Gene_Kind %in% c("biosynthetic", "biosynthetic-additional") & status_8h == "Up", na.rm = TRUE),
    All_Bio_Up_13h     = sum(Gene_Kind %in% c("biosynthetic", "biosynthetic-additional") & status_13h == "Up", na.rm = TRUE),
    
    # DEGs totales (8h vs 13h)
    DEGs_Up_8h         = sum(status_8h == "Up", na.rm = TRUE),
    DEGs_Up_13h        = sum(status_13h == "Up", na.rm = TRUE),
    DEGs_Down_8h       = sum(status_8h == "Down", na.rm = TRUE),
    DEGs_Down_13h      = sum(status_13h == "Down", na.rm = TRUE),
    
    # Promedio Regional
    Mean_LFC_8h        = round(mean(LFC_8h, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    Mean_LFC_13h       = round(mean(LFC_13h, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    .groups            = "drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(All_Bio_Up_13h), desc(All_Bio_Up_8h))

#-----------------------------------#
# TABLA MEMORIA de principales BGCs #
#-----------------------------------#
bgc_main_compact <- bgc_dynamics_table %>%
  select(
    Region, 
    BGC_Product, 
    Total_Genes, 
    Total_Biosynthetic, 
    All_Bio_Up_8h, 
    All_Bio_Up_13h, 
    Mean_LFC_8h, 
    Mean_LFC_13h) %>%
  # Saltos de línea en palabras compuestas reemplazando '/' por '/ '
  mutate(BGC_Product = str_replace_all(BGC_Product, "/", "/ "))

# Construcción de la tabla con anchos recalibrados
ft_main <- bgc_main_compact %>%
  flextable() %>%
  set_header_labels(
    Region             = "Region",
    BGC_Product        = "Producto Biosintético",
    Total_Genes        = "Total Genes",
    Total_Biosynthetic = "Genes Bio.",
    All_Bio_Up_8h      = "Bio. Up\n(8 h)",
    All_Bio_Up_13h     = "Bio. Up\n(13 h)",
    Mean_LFC_8h        = "LFC Prom.\n(8 h)",
    Mean_LFC_13h       = "LFC Prom.\n(13 h)") %>%
  theme_vanilla() %>%
  
  # Estilo de fuente y alineaciones
  fontsize(size = 8.5, part = "all") %>%
  fontsize(size = 8.5, part = "header") %>%
  bold(part = "header") %>%
  align(align = "center", part = "body") %>%
  align(j = c("Region", "BGC_Product"), align = "left", part = "body") %>%
  
  # Anchos ajustados para un ancho de página A4 estándar (aprox 6.5 pulgadas útiles)
  width(j = "Region", width = 0.7) %>%
  width(j = "BGC_Product", width = 1.3) %>%
  width(j = c("Total_Genes", "Total_Biosynthetic"), width = 0.7) %>%
  width(j = c("All_Bio_Up_8h", "All_Bio_Up_13h"), width = 0.8) %>%
  width(j = c("Mean_LFC_8h", "Mean_LFC_13h"), width = 0.8) %>%
  
  # Compactar relleno vertical y horizontal
  padding(padding.top = 3, padding.bottom = 3, padding.left = 2, padding.right = 2, part = "all")

# 3. Exportar a Word
save_as_docx(ft_main, path = here("results/Tabla_BGC_Dynamics_Formatted.docx"))
```

```{r}
# FIGURA 1: Heatmap dinámico (Mean LFC 8h vs 13h)           
mat_bgc <- bgc_dynamics_table %>%
  select(Region, Mean_LFC_8h, Mean_LFC_13h) %>%
  column_to_rownames("Region") %>%
  rename("8 h" = Mean_LFC_8h, "13 h" = Mean_LFC_13h) %>%
  as.matrix()

# Paleta personalizada (azul = repressed, rojo = Induced)
my_palette <- colorRampPalette(c("royalblue", "white", "red"))(100) # Colores

print(
pheatmap(
  mat_bgc, 
  display_numbers = TRUE,
  number_format = "%.2f",
  cluster_rows = TRUE,       # Agrupación de clústers por comportamiento
  cluster_cols = FALSE,
  color = my_palette,
  breaks = seq(-1.8, 1.8, length.out = 101),
  fontsize_title  = 10,
  angle_col = "0",
  main = "Dinámica Transcripcional de BGCs (Mean LFC 8h vs 13h)",
  filename = here("results/figures/Fig_Dinamica_Transcripcional_de_BGCs.png"),
  width = 6, height = 7))

# FIGURA 2: Respuesta de Maquinaria Biosintética a las 13h           
fig_biosynthetic_13h <- bgc_deg_master %>%
  filter(Gene_Kind %in% c("biosynthetic", "biosynthetic-additional")) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = reorder(Region, as.numeric(str_extract(Region, "\\d+"))), fill = status_13h)) +
  geom_bar(position = "stack", color = "black", linewidth = 0.3, width = 0.7) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("Up" = "red","Down" = "royalblue","NoDEG" = "grey"),

    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    legend.position  = "top",
    axis.title       = element_text(face = "bold")) +
  labs(
    title = "Estado Transcripcional de Genes Biosintéticos (13 h)",
    x     = "Región Biosintética (BGC)",
    y     = "Número de Genes (Core + Additional)",
    fill  = "Respuesta:")

print(fig_biosynthetic_13h)

# Exportación

  filename = here("results/figures/Fig_Estado_Transcripcional_de_Genes_Biosintéticos.png"),
```

```{r}
#------------------#
# Tabla MEMORIA QC #
#------------------#
tsv_path <- normalizePath(here("reports", "sequencing_report_table.tsv"))
df <- read.delim(tsv_path, check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# Limpieza de asteriscos y espacios residuales
df[] <- lapply(df, function(x) gsub("\\*\\*", "", trimws(x)))

# Identificar el número de columnas para repartir anchos dinámicamente o fijar manualmente
num_cols <- ncol(df)

# Construcción de la tabla con flextable
ft_qc <- flextable(df) %>%
  theme_vanilla() %>%
  
  # Tipografía uniforme
  fontsize(size = 8.5, part = "all") %>%
  fontsize(size = 8.5, part = "header") %>%
  bold(part = "header") %>%
  bg(bg = "white", part = "header") %>%
  
  # Alineación: texto descriptivo a la izquierda, métricas/números al centro
  align(align = "center", part = "all") %>%
  align(j = 1:2, align = "left", part = "body") %>%
  
  # Ajustado diseño A4
  width(j = 1, width = 1.8) %>%
  width(j = 2, width = 1.1) %>%
  width(j = 3:num_cols, width = (6.5 - 1.8 - 1.1) / (num_cols - 2)) %>%
  set_table_properties(layout = "fixed") %>%
  padding(padding.top = 3, padding.bottom = 3, padding.left = 2, padding.right = 2, part = "all")

# Exportación directa a la carpeta results como .docx
save_as_docx(ft_qc, path = here("results/Tabla_QC_Summary_Formatted.docx"))
```
